name: Low-voltage transformers
summary: Mains transformers that step down to about 6–48V AC: doorbells, HVAC, halogen lights and old adapters.
uses: Low-voltage AC for pumps, valves and lights
Building a linear power supply or battery charger
identify: Heavy iron-core blocks or round toroids in old stereos, battery chargers, halogen lighting, doorbells, HVAC systems (24V) and older wall adapters. The label gives input and output volts and VA.
test: The primary winding reads higher resistance than the secondary. Powered, measure the AC output; it reads a bit high with no load.
